name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard encodes 'open the door, then take the box', and Existence(target_picked_up) hard requires the box. Together they force door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed. Absence(key_lost) soft matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost is a key drop with the door shut, and 'try not to' is a preference cue. The key and ball prerequisites come from the environment and need no clauses.

texts: Open the door before taking the box from the other room: the target box must not be picked up before the door is open.
The agent must take the target box from the other room (pick up the target box).
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, so the key_lost event should never occur.
